card: Adds unit tests for malformed partial merkle trees and difficulty target calculation edge cases. It verifies behavior at the partial merkle tree 16,666 transaction limit boundary and checks that GetBitsProof returns zero for zero, negative, and overflowing targets. The missing test coverage was identified while working on an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s).
evidence: Author description: 'These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)'
problem: Bitcoin Core lacks explicit unit test coverage for partial merkle tree boundary conditions and edge-case target inputs to GetBitsProof, leaving room for regressions or ambiguous behavior across implementations.

risk.why: The patch only adds unit tests, so a bug could cause CI or test suite failures but cannot affect node operation or consensus.

scope_notes: Small, test-only addition across two files (+46/-0 lines).
summary: Adds unit tests covering edge cases in partial merkle trees and difficulty target calculations. Specifically, it exercises malformed partial merkle trees at the 16,666 transaction limit boundary and verifies that GetBitsProof returns zero for zero, negative, and overflowing target values.
